login.phoneHint: SMS sign-in is not configured. Add TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, and TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE_SID (preferred) or TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER as Cloudflare Worker Runtime secrets.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.updated: Last updated September 15, 2026. This is an MVP stub — have counsel review before production use.
paragraphs: InvoiceFlow Studio (invoiceflowstudio.com) is a tool for creating, sending, and tracking invoices and proposals. It is not a bank, accountant, tax advisor, or payment processor for your client invoices in this MVP.
You own the content you upload. You are responsible for the accuracy of invoices, tax, and client communications. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.
Subscriptions (Pro) renew monthly via Stripe until cancelled. Free-plan limits are enforced in software and may change with notice.
The software is provided “as is” without warranties. Limit of liability is the amount you paid us in the prior three months.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.updated: Last updated September 15, 2026. Stub for the MVP — replace with a reviewed policy before launch.
paragraphs: We collect account email, studio profile details, invoices, proposals, and billing metadata needed to run the product.
Auth may use email/password, Google, GitHub OAuth, and optional Resend magic links. Payments go through Stripe; we store customer and subscription IDs, not full card numbers.
Public share links are unguessable tokens. Anyone with the link can view the document. Don’t send tokens you want to keep private.
Contact the operator at invoiceflowstudio.com to request export or deletion of your account data.

estimatesPage.headline: Price the job. Send the estimate. Get the yes.
estimatesPage.lede: InvoiceFlow Studio is the focused way to write a branded estimate, send a PDF or share link, and know when a client opened or approved it — without turning your week into bookkeeping.
estimatesPage.freeNote: Starter includes 3 estimates a month. Works from a phone. No 47-step wizard.

themes.title: Price the job right
themes.body: Walk the scope once, write it down, and send a number you can stand behind. Accurate estimates keep the work profitable before a single material is ordered.

themes.title: Estimate on the spot
themes.body: Build a detailed quote from your phone on the jobsite. Add labor, materials, and notes while the client is still looking at the work — then send the link before you leave.

themes.title: Look like a pro
themes.body: Every estimate carries your studio name, colors, and a clean PDF. Clients see a branded document, not a screenshot of a spreadsheet.

themes.title: Price with confidence
themes.body: Itemize the work, add markup, and apply tax. The total updates as you type so you know the number before the client does.

themes.title: Get approvals faster
themes.body: Clients open the estimate on their phone, review the line items, type their name, and approve online. No print-sign-scan loop.

themes.title: Photos, files, and repeat jobs
themes.body: Attach photo and file names from the site, reuse saved line items, and start from a job template so the next similar job is already half written.

buildItems: Itemized pricing so the client sees labor, materials, and the why.
Saved items and templates for the jobs you already know how to price.
Photos and files listed on the estimate so the scope is visual, not just a paragraph.
Digital signature: type a name, approve online, done.
Notifications when it is opened or approved (email when a studio address is set; otherwise we mark it on the dashboard).
Phone-first layout for the driveway, the hallway, or the last five minutes of a site visit.
estimatesPage.qbLede: When the job becomes an invoice, the numbers should already match. InvoiceFlow Studio is built to sync invoices and estimates with QuickBooks Online so you are not retyping line items for your accountant.
qbItems: Connect once — we remember the company file.
Daily automatic sync, or tap Sync now after a big day of jobs.
Invoices and estimates stay in step so the books match the work.
Your accountant can work from QuickBooks Online; you keep sending from InvoiceFlow Studio.

estimatesPage.notifyLede: The public estimate link records a first open and an online approval. If you have a studio email, InvoiceFlow Studio sends a short note. Either way, the dashboard shows Opened and Approved so you can follow up while the job is still warm.

referralTerms.title: Referral Program Terms & Conditions
referralTerms.updated: Last updated September 19, 2026. Stub for the MVP — replace with a reviewed policy before launch.
paragraphs: InvoiceFlow Studio pays a cash reward when someone you invite subscribes to Pro and stays subscribed for the qualifying period shown in Settings.
Rewards are a placeholder in this release. Earnings, weekly balances, and payouts are not processed yet.
Referral links use invoiceflowstudio.com/r/ followed by your unique code. Do not use competitor domains or impersonate another studio.
We may change, pause, or end the referral program with notice. Abuse, self-referrals, and fake accounts are not eligible.
